name: @pipeworx/mcp-factline-nl

tools.name: nl_address_facts
tools.description: Facts about any Dutch address, in English, from official registers: year built, building age, floor area, use (residential/retail/...), BAG ids, coordinates, municipality, province, neighbourhood name and code, neighbourhood residents/households/average home value (WOZ)/owner-occupied share, the Leefbaarometer liveability percentile, energy label where registered, and municipality house-price trend. Input is postcode + house number (+ optional letter/addition). Example: {"postcode":"1012JS","house_number":1} -> Dam 1, Amsterdam, built 1914, 23,820 m2 retail, neighbourhood Oude Kerk e.o. Unresolvable addresses return found:false with a reason. Returns source and data_as_of (year of the neighbourhood and liveability figures).

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, 4 digits + 2 letters, e.g. "1012JS" (a space is fine)

tools.name: nl_vehicle_by_plate
tools.description: Look up a Dutch licence plate (kenteken) in the vehicle authority register: make, model, vehicle type, colour, first registration date, age, fuel, euro class, APK (MOT) expiry and whether it is valid, insured flag, open recall flag, odometer verdict (consistent / suspect) and an overall risk level. Describes the VEHICLE only; no owner or personal data is requested or returned. Example: {"licence_plate":"GT722F"} -> Mazda CX-3, APK valid to 2027-08-14. An unregistered plate returns found:false. Returns source and data_as_of (retrieval date).

licence_plate.description: Dutch licence plate, with or without dashes, e.g. "GT-722-F" or "GT722F"

tools.name: nl_schools_near_postcode
tools.description: The nearest primary and secondary schools to a Dutch postcode, with name, address, denomination, pupil count, website, distance in km, and the latest end-of-primary test results (reading and maths share reaching target vs the national share) or secondary exam pass rates, from the national education register. Example: {"postcode":"1011AB"} -> OBS IJplein 0.68 km, De Witte Olifant 0.84 km, ... Returns source and data_as_of (latest register update date among the schools).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-factline-nl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the factline-nl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
